implementation_review_focus: Verify the final branch actually returns before Api on every census outcome, including all-approved entries; reject --abi/--recognize/wrong executable/runtime in the census parent.
At exactly64 retained entries, the64th Next call must distinguish natural end from an extra65th entry; caps cannot fabricate completion.
Record successful query error status without stale GetLastError; errors and clipped paths must not invent a full returned length.
Confirm total-artifact reserve/framing accounting and append/flush results; publication failure or partial bytes must veto complete collection even when a summary is written.
The validator must recompute ordinal/count/hex/type/byte/completeness relations and keep unknown/unlisted metadata separate from approvals; no filesystem lookup on reported paths.
Review exact separately pinned status-only sealer AST, globals/closure binding, failure matrix and terminal universe before any activation.
limitations: Source/design only; planned validators/formatters/sealer are not implemented or executed by this record.
Native DLL/CRT initializers may have effects during loading; zero explicit queries is not zero OS side effects.
A current-process snapshot has documented API exclusions and cannot establish load cause, full process lifetime or unknown file/loaded-byte identity.
remaining_gates: Root accepts this design before implementation.
Source-only implementation and pure fault evidence require independent exact review.
Bounded build protocol/compile verification and a distinct fixed census parent/protocol each need separate review/root decisions.
No current image read, census API, compiler, child or policy edit is authorized by this design peer record.
reviewed_properties: One separately named --module-census role after the same core4 load order, before Api construction, with unconditional return and zero target export resolution/public C queries. No baseline or causal phase is included.

Exactly one non-inherited current-process module snapshot; at most64 retained entries, First1/Next64/path-query64. No other PID/process/thread/heap enumeration and no automatic ERROR_BAD_LENGTH retry.

At most2MiB total child structured artifacts including framing, with64KiB reserved for attempt/terminal/error records. Existing64KiB row/stdout/stderr and parent/Job/time/memory limits remain. Cap exhaustion is partial, never a reason to expand bounds.

Raw snapshot name and one bounded query path response remain distinct, with return/error/timing, clipping, actual-length-unknown semantics, prefix/UTF16 code units and optional UTF8. Reported strings are never followed as files or loaded/pinned.
Rows are append/flushed before classification. Unknown entries do not stop capture, and classification against the existing list is metadata-only rather than eligibility.

Natural end, metadata completeness, publication, parent resource validation and sealed integrity are separate. Positive census needs natural ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES plus durable lossless untruncated identity metadata/counts and existing clean parent conditions; no full lifetime/system/datafile inventory is claimed.
A distinct strict census validator/status is required. Positive census with unlisted names must keep ABI_eligibility_established=false and may not invoke any typed target API.

Original SDK3bf and its gate/sealer remain unchanged. A separately pinned make_sealer copy may change only the success literal, with whole-function AST normalization proof and direct call from new parent, no SDK monkeypatch.

Primary/interruption/late-close/publication/postseal vetoes and cleanup-only cancellation persist. Planned fake tests cover caps, natural/end errors, clipping/hex, publication, unlisted completeness, fabricated counts/flags, argv and literal-only sealer behavior.

Current apphelp metadata does not identify earlier failures, authenticate file bytes or establish a compatibility fix/load cause. All unknowns are reviewed as a batch; any later image inspection/policy revision requires separate scope and root decision.
